investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (290 files) was observed from the user globalcorp@globalcorp.ee, significantly above the 24-hour baseline of 50. The activity originated from Tallinn, Estonia, using Directo MSGraph with a generic user agent, and includes sample files and paths indicating bulk access across multiple document types. While the site appears to be a corporate SharePoint location, the combination of high data volume, automated-looking user agent, and the timing relative to normal activity warrants HP classification and further investigation.
